build: Tasks, part 2 (issue #51, Part 2; builds.md, Nursery lane). On Tasks: Upcoming weeks, one card under both lists with a line for each of the next four weeks (for Nursery and Field: tasks, trays, how many of each kind, the varieties' photographs; a press goes to that week); "Mark all done" on Late and on Today when a group has three tasks or more, late ones asked one day for all of them, or each on the day it was due; a flag on a planting out or a sowing in the ground whose bed another planting still holds that day ("Bed not free until …"), beside the seed-short flag, each one line that never wraps; "Trays to fill" at the head of Nursery (trays, rockwool sheets, cubic feet of mix and varieties for the sowings on screen, a tag a tray size); a tick a week or more before its day asks first and says what it would move; "⋯" holds "Take back everything recorded…", a sheet that counts what goes back (sowings with their seed, other tasks, what was put off, what was skipped; notes and failed marks stay), a snapshot first, one step with Undo. On a planting's panel: "Mark as failed…", a day from its start to today, which says first the day its bed is free, what comes off the forecast in its own unit and dollars, and the tasks that leave the list; marked, it stays on record greyed on the Timeline, with "Take the mark off". New in the plan: plantings[].failed { on, at }, taken whole when two devices meet (tests/plan_shape.cjs, js/merge.js WHOLE); the engine ends its harvest the day before and frees its bed from that day; its open work leaves Tasks and the seed count. A day recorded a year or more before the plan's own is refused ("Sown on" and every job), and the panel's calendars stop short of it. Copies of a planting do not carry the mark. Nothing moves in a plan with no failed mark.

changes.did: Tasks shows the next four weeks, Trays to fill, a bed that is not free yet and Mark all done; a tick a week ahead asks first; "⋯" takes back everything recorded. A planting can be marked failed on its panel.
steps: On Tasks, under both lists, "Upcoming weeks" lists the next four weeks; press one and that week opens.

On a Late group of three tasks or more, "Mark all done" asks one day for all of them, or each on the day it was due, and says what each choice would move as you point at it. Close it with × to record nothing.
Click a planting on the Map, then "Mark as failed…": the line under the day says when its bed is free and what comes off the forecast. Press Cancel to leave it.
